Specification: This specification models a simple integer countdown system with a single state variable x initialized to the constant N. The assumption requires N to be a natural number, and the transition relation decrements x by 1 while x is positive, otherwise it stutters when x = 0. The main safety property defined in the file is the invariant Inv asserting that x remains nonnegative throughout execution.
